title: Incentive Rate Schedule — Demand Response Programs
content:
## Incentive rates

The incentives earned under each of the Demand Response Programs are paid at the rates below. A rate of $0.00 means that the program does not pay that kind of incentive.

### One-time and seasonal incentives (USD)

| Program | Enrollment bonus, earned once when the enrollment becomes active | Seasonal incentive, for completing an event season within the opt-out limit |
|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | $75.00 | $25.00 |
| AC Cycling Program | $50.00 | $0.00 |
| Home Battery Dispatch | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Base Interruptible Program | $0.00 | $0.00 |

### Monthly participation credit

| Program | Credit per participation month | Billing months that earn the credit |
|---|---|---|
| AC Cycling Program | $10.00 | Bills whose billing period ends in June, July, August or September |
| All other programs | $0.00 | Not applicable |

### Event, performance and capacity rates

| Program | Rebate per kWh reduced below baseline in an event | Incentive per kW of average delivered discharge over a season's events | Capacity payment per committed kW per program month | Energy payment per kWh delivered in events |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | $1.25 per kWh | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| AC Cycling Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Home Battery Dispatch | $0.00 | $275.00 per kW per season | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | $8.50 per kW-month | $0.12 per kWh |
| Base Interruptible Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | $10.75 per kW-month | $0.00 |

## Rates by program at a glance

- **Peak Time Rebate:** $1.25 for each kWh reduced below baseline during an event; no bonus, seasonal, monthly or capacity incentive.
- **Smart Thermostat Rewards:** a $75.00 enrollment bonus and a $25.00 seasonal incentive.
- **AC Cycling Program:** a $50.00 enrollment bonus and a $10.00 credit for each participation month (bills whose billing period ends in June, July, August or September).
- **Home Battery Dispatch:** $275.00 per kW of average delivered discharge over the season's events.
- **Commercial Capacity Bidding Program:** $8.50 per committed kW for each program month, plus $0.12 per kWh delivered during events.
- **Base Interruptible Program:** $10.75 per committed kW for each program month.

## Rate questions

**Does any business program pay an enrollment bonus?** No. The enrollment bonus is $75.00 for Smart Thermostat Rewards and $50.00 for the AC Cycling Program; it is $0.00 for every other program.

**Which program pays both a capacity rate and an energy rate?** Only the Commercial Capacity Bidding Program ($8.50 per kW-month and $0.12 per kWh).

**Which AC Cycling bills earn the $10.00 credit?** Bills whose billing period ends in June, July, August or September. A bill whose billing period ends in May or October is not in the list.
